name: Côr Leader Mair

intro.text: The choir sings in Welsh, the audience claps in Spanish, and I conduct in whatever comes out. Altos, from the top!

win: Lovely. That was very nearly in tune.
after: Y Wladfa's chapels and choirs kept Welsh going for generations: the chapel was school, court and concert hall, and the hymns were the first Welsh many children learnt.
